【原视频简介】
Ever wondered how to tell if your garden watermelon is actually ripe before you cut it open? In today's episode of Yard to Table Appalachian Homesteading, we are heading into the garden to harvest the perfect watermelon and some beautiful ornamental corn. Join us as we explore the rewards of a summer harvest and turn our hard work into a delicious, refreshing treat.

In this video, we walk you through the practical process of checking watermelon tendrils and yellow bellies to ensure peak sweetness. We also harvest a variety of decorative corn, discussing the vibrant colors like blue and pink that make for excellent fall wreaths and decor. You will learn how to identify common garden pests like squash bugs and see what happens when corn faces disease or poor pollination.

To wrap things up, Mary shares her special recipe for a healthy watermelon smoothie. This drink uses frozen strawberries, bananas, milk, and local honey for a perfect summer cooldown without any added sugar. Whether you are a seasoned gardener or just starting your homesteading journey, there is plenty of helpful advice on harvesting and enjoying your produce.
